title: Overcoming Obstacles
coreMove: Wealth grows when you diagnose the blocker, then answer it with analysis, priority, discipline, learning, or a small controlled risk.

exampleSpecs.audience: a first-time investor deciding how to size a risk
exampleSpecs.stakes: A useful deal can be rejected because one loss feels like proof to quit.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show fear of loss being managed with Texas-style pride and careful risk sizing.

exampleSpecs.audience: an analyst sorting rumor from evidence
exampleSpecs.stakes: Cynical chatter can stop a deal before anyone checks the facts.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Turn Chicken Little warnings into analysis instead of paralysis.

exampleSpecs.audience: a household naming the real obstacle
exampleSpecs.stakes: The wrong cure wastes effort when the blocker is misnamed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the five obstacle list to diagnose the active blocker.

exampleSpecs.audience: a freelancer trying to protect asset money
exampleSpecs.stakes: The asset account receives nothing when everyone else gets paid first.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show paying oneself first as discipline and pressure, not bill neglect.

exampleSpecs.audience: an owner avoiding a money conversation through tasks
exampleSpecs.stakes: Useful financial action disappears under harmless busywork.

exampleSpecs.audience: an entrepreneur deciding whether to admit a knowledge gap
exampleSpecs.stakes: Pretended expertise can turn ignorance into a costly contract.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show arrogance as ego plus ignorance and answer it with education.
